# RetailPulse — DAX Measure Audit

**Date:** 2026-11-20 (fix-Phase 4) · **Generated by** `scripts/build_dax_audit.py` from `dax_measures.md` and `dax_validation_results.csv`. Do not edit by hand.

**Result:** 84 measures (49 original + 35 new) · **230/230 checks pass** · every measure ID covered

> **Scope.** Each check compares the measure's logic, emulated in pandas over the CSVs Power BI imports, with an independent SQL answer from the base tables. That proves the rows, denominators, grain, filter handling and BLANK behaviour are right *as written*. It does **not** prove DAX syntax or Power BI runtime behaviour, which need Windows.

## Summary of the 49 original measures

| Status | Measures |
|---|---|
| Validated, unchanged | 32: M01, M02, M03, M04, M05, M06, M08, M16, M17, M18, M19, M20, M21, M24, M25, M26, M29, M30, M34, M36, M37, M38, M39, M41, M42, M43, M44, M45, M46, M47, M48, M49 |
| Validated; validator check fixed | 1: M07 |
| FIXED: formula bug | 2: M11, M40 |
| FIXED: filter context | 8: M09, M10, M12, M13, M14, M15, M27, M28 |
| FIXED: weighting / grain | 3: M32, M33, M35 |
| FIXED: wrong source table | 2: M22, M23 |
| Clarified: label / additivity | 1: M31 |

Before this audit the validator had 37 checks: 33 on documented measures (one of them, M07, compared a constant with itself) and 4 on helper figures with no documented DAX. So **17 of the 49 measures had no real check**: M07, M09–M12, M15, M16, M22, M23, M25, M27, M28, M31–M33, M35, M39. Every measure now has at least one, most several, in different filter contexts.

## What was wrong, by category

| Problem type | Measures | Evidence (bug-reproduction check) |
|---|---|---|
| Formula bug | M11, M40 | M11: old formula averages DAILY revenue: 30,716 vs correct monthly 921,468 (x0.033). M40: 1 - BLANK evaluates to 1, so an empty context (e.g. order_status = unavailable) showed 100% on time |
| Filter context | M09, M10, M12, M13–M15, M27, M28 | M12: the YearMonth axis filter survives, so the 'running total' equals that month's revenue only (429,917 vs 2,065,044). M15: the YearMonth slicer is kept, intersects 2017 with 2018 -> Revenue 2017 Jan-Aug is BLANK -> YoY BLANK. M10: old MoM at 2017-01 = 1,101,719% against a 1-order month; the fix returns BLANK unless both months are complete. M27/M28: DAX-semantics finding (see validator notes) |
| Weighting / grain | M32, M33, M35 | unweighted mean of seller rates 8.42% (and in percent units, unlike every other rate) vs weighted 8.02% (platform order-level 8.11%) |
| Wrong source table | M22, M23 | vw_customer_summary has no segment column and is on the ONE side, so a segment filter cannot reach it: every segment would show 96,096 |
| Label / additivity | M31 | counts seller-order pairs (99,542), not orders (98,199) |
| Validator tautology | M07 | `SELECT 86.90` compared with 86.90; now an independent SQL median |
| Affected by the new analytical sources | M22, M23 (moved to RFM), M27, M28 (dim_category axis), M32, M33, M35 (seller_scorecard) | — |

## Validation evidence

| Check group | Pass |
|---|---|
| measure | 202/202 |
| supporting | 3/3 |
| fan-out guard | 7/7 |
| coverage | 3/3 |
| bug reproduction | 15/15 |

Every check, with model value, expected value and context: `powerbi/dax_validation_results.csv`.

**Bug reproductions** (old formula evaluated; passes only when shown wrong):

- **M11 Revenue 3M Moving Avg**, old DATESINPERIOD formula at 2018-03: old formula averages DAILY revenue: 30,716 vs correct monthly 921,468 (x0.033)
- **M12 Revenue Running Total**, old ALLSELECTED(dim_date[Date]) on a YearMonth axis at 2017-06: the YearMonth axis filter survives, so the 'running total' equals that month's revenue only (429,917 vs 2,065,044)
- **M15 YoY Growth Jan-Aug %**, old Year/MonthNo filters under a 2018-01..08 YearMonth slicer: the YearMonth slicer is kept, intersects 2017 with 2018 -> Revenue 2017 Jan-Aug is BLANK -> YoY BLANK
- **M10 Revenue MoM %**, old DATEADD formula at 2017-01 (previous month is 1 order in Dec 2016): old MoM at 2017-01 = 1,101,719% against a 1-order month; the fix returns BLANK unless both months are complete
- **M22 Customers In Segment**, old COUNTROWS(vw_customer_summary) under a segment filter: vw_customer_summary has no segment column and is on the ONE side, so a segment filter cannot reach it: every segment would show 96,096
- **N05 Cohort Retention %**, naive denominator (all cohort sizes) at offset 1: including the right-censored 2018-08 cohort in the denominator understates offset-1 retention (0.004730 vs 0.005062)
- **N11 Product Avg Item Price**, AVERAGE(product_performance[avg_item_price]) instead of revenue / units: unweighted mean of product prices 144.96 vs true average item price 120.38
- **M33 Seller Late Rate**, old AVERAGE(vw_seller_performance[late_pct]): unweighted mean of seller rates 8.42% (and in percent units, unlike every other rate) vs weighted 8.02% (platform order-level 8.11%)
- **M32 Seller Avg Delivery Days**, old AVERAGE(vw_seller_performance[avg_delivery_days]): unweighted 12.21 vs weighted 12.51 days
- **M35 Seller Inherited Order Rating**, old AVERAGE(vw_seller_performance[avg_review_score]): unweighted 4.055 vs weighted 4.099
- **M40 On-Time Delivery Rate**, old 1 - [Late Delivery Rate] with no measurable orders: 1 - BLANK evaluates to 1, so an empty context (e.g. order_status = unavailable) showed 100% on time
- **N29 Category Review Count**, plain SUM(category_satisfaction[review_count]) at the total: a plain SUM gives 99,273, more than the reviews that exist, because multi-category orders count in each category
- **N30 Category Avg Review Score**, item-weighted, eligible-only category score (notebook 03 / Insight 14 method): repeating each order's score per item moves 5 of 34 categories (>=300 items) across the overall average 4.0864: auto, drinks, electronics, garden_tools, housewares
- **X02 Revenue reconciliation**, naive items x payments join: would report 14,105,767.00 (+4.53%)
- **X03 Revenue reconciliation**, naive items x reviews inner join: would report 13,431,884.80 (-0.46%)
